title_zh: 比较材质后选一只日常用包

scenario.goal_zh: 核对材质、尺寸及价格，比较日常使用需要后选定购买的手袋

context_zh: 顾客妮娅在店里比较两只可装笔记本的包。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Is this brown bag made of leather?

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: Yes. The blue one beside it is cotton, so it is lighter and costs less.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: The brown one is beautiful, but at that price it would be a luxury for me.

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: What will you carry in it most days?

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: A notebook and my lunch. A medium bag should be enough; the large one looks awkward.

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: Try your notebook in the blue one. The label shows both the size and the price.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: It fits, and the straps feel comfortable. I will take this one for thirty pounds.

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: Certainly. I will remove the display tag and ring it up for you.

targets.sense_zh: 非必需的奢侈享受或物品
